faq: Do I need accounts on both stores?

Only for the stores you want to publish on. The Apple Developer Program and Google Play Console are billed by Apple and Google. We guide you through both and ask to be added as a team member, never for your password.
Will the app feel native on each phone?

Flutter draws its own interface, and we adjust the details that matter, such as scrolling, back navigation and system fonts, so each platform feels familiar. Some native features use platform code, which we add when needed.
You do. At handover you get the full Flutter project, build notes and a list of packages with their licences. Nothing is locked to us.
Will both stores approve the app?
Each store decides on its own. We build to both sets of rules and prepare privacy details and review notes, but we cannot promise approval. If a store asks for changes, we help you respond.
